scope: Proposal-level semantic and identity review of the frozen 180-object N06 cohort; no source or runtime acceptance

advisoryReceipt.interpretation: Warnings are advisory; no numeric threshold is used. Manual review identified a systematic answer-form cue in the four groups below.

blockingFindings.requirement: Existing quality specification §4.3: options should have comparable concreteness and must remove a systematic longest-is-correct signal.
blockingFindings.finding: The keyed response repeatedly contains the only complete policy while its distractors are abbreviated alternatives. Across these groups, the longest-choice form is a reliable shortcut independent of the scenario facts.
blockingFindings.minimalCorrection: Tighten keyed choices to the already-visible mechanism decision, or make nearest wrong alternatives comparably concrete and retain their specific error. Do not pad options or change the underlying accepted meaning merely to alter length.

units.example: i003 key 155 characters, longest distractor 102; the two-part policy-interface/stable-workflow form recurs across the flagged cases.
i001 key 170 characters, longest distractor 106; the key repeats captured inputs, validation and unchanged-on-rejection as a complete recipe.
i001 key 155 characters, longest distractor 122; the keyed choice repeatedly names participants and preserves their local ownership in a longer complete policy.

All 18 answers are sole-longest. In i001 the key is 138 characters versus a 78-character longest distractor; the repeated distractors are generic 43–99-character fragments while the keyed choice states the scenario-specific complete boundary.

crossUnitReview.verdict: No material duplicate decision found in the reviewed N06 cohort or nearest accepted N01-N05 controls.
distinctions: B01 Strategy selects replaceable behavior at a stable workflow seam; B07 Template Method keeps an invariant host-owned skeleton and varies a designated step.
B03 Command captures a proposed operation and inputs before execution; B09 event publishes an accepted persisted fact.
B04 Observer subscribers react to subject changes; B09 domain events communicate accepted business facts to retryable consumers.
B05 Mediator coordinates peer calls while participants retain domain rules; B10 Saga sequences external effects and handles permitted compensation/retry.
B06 Chain tries ordered handlers with applicability/pass/stop outcomes; B07 Template Method runs a fixed algorithm with a variation point.
B09 event publication and B10 workflow orchestration reuse some domain settings, but ask about different boundaries: accepted-fact publication versus multi-step failure/compensation decisions.
crossUnitReview.acceptedControls: Compared to the 765 accepted N01-N05 objects through the existing accepted evidence and the frozen current registry; this report does not claim a fresh review of every accepted object.

limitations: The report is a semantic and identity review of proposals only.
It does not accept source integration, producer migration, consumer implementation, app admission, runtime/native/Premium behavior, full-bank eligibility, or full BIZQ-01 closure.
The current registry is a frozen input binding, not approval of the identity map or source activation.
